lines.369680623199662082: I’ve got at least a hundred pounds on you.
lines.369680623203856384: Let’s see how long you last.
lines.369680623216439296: You don’t know when to quit, do you?
lines.369680623224827904: You got me, son. You got me good.
lines.369680623224827907: Why? Why did you get in my way?
lines.369680623229022209: What was the point of all of this?
lines.369680623233216513: I feel so much better now.
lines.369680623237410816: Are you okay? What happened to your hands?
lines.369680623237410817: Can you smell it? The smoke. I burned it all.
lines.369680623237410819: I had to. I had to get rid of everything. It was the only way to make him leave me alone.
lines.369680623241605120: It's bittersweet. I can feel something coming to an end. I know he won't be coming back now.
lines.369680623241605122: Not anymore. He used to be, the little man. But it wasn't really me he was after.
lines.369680623241605123: It was all those things that I was hanging on to...
lines.369680623245799424: Look, it isn't safe to be out here.
lines.369680623245799425: It doesn't matter anymore. Everything is going to be all right.
lines.369680623245799426: The little man will find you soon enough.
lines.369680623275159553: What do you mean? I'm already free.
lines.369680623275159554: No, you're not. You don't even know what's holding you back.
lines.369680623275159555: All the trinkets you're carrying around, bits and pieces you think are important, but really they're weighing you down.
lines.369680623279353856: Come back when you've gathered all of them and we'll burn them together.
lines.369680623300325376: You've destroyed everything you own, and it's made you free?
lines.369680623308713984: It's not just about the things themselves, it's what they represent.
